report_name: No-Semantics Prototype Gate and Equivalence Checklist

prototype_decision.prerequisite: Evidence pipeline must show P_trace_to_sim_slice > 15% OR P_trace_to_sim_step > 15% with measured (not placeholder) data
prototype_decision.current_status: Pending: evidence currently uses placeholder data. Must recalibrate with measured timing.

allowed: decoded static-info cache: cache (unique_function_id, pc) → static metadata lookups to avoid repeated binding
metadata normalization cache: cache normalized frontend field values for repeated config records
threadblock chunk staging: batch threadblock/warp trace construction into larger chunks before simulator consumption
local replay: make parser-to-frontend chunks replayable for debugging and performance regression isolation
forbidden: Any change to warp issue order
Any change to memory pipeline timing
Any change to SM backend timing state
Dynamic GPU instruction squash or semantic compression

equivalence_checklist.tolerance: must match baseline exactly (derived from sim_cycle and sim_insn)

equivalence_checklist.description: L1/L2 cache hit/miss counts and rates
Order in which kernels are launched and completed

equivalence_checklist.tolerance: No new warnings introduced; existing warning count unchanged
No new fatal conditions. Prototype must not crash on any workload the baseline handles.
Expected reduction per model (15-50% of T_trace_to_sim). Must NOT regress.

gate_decision_flow: 1. Evidence pipeline confirms P_trace_to_sim > 15% with measured data
2. Prototype scope document approved (only allowed changes at parser/frontend boundary)
3. Baseline run: record all equivalence metrics on unmodified simulator
4. Prototype build: implement only allowed changes
5. Equivalence run: record all metrics on modified simulator
6. Compare: all P0 metrics must match exactly; P1 metrics must match; P2 metrics must not regress
7. If any P0/P1 metric differs: prototype is REJECTED, must debug and re-run
8. If all metrics match: prototype is accepted for performance evaluation
9. Performance claim: only report T_trace_to_sim reduction AFTER equivalence confirmed
deferred_to_separate_spec: Any change that modifies sim_cycle or sim_insn output
